title: HearthBreaker Challenge
description: Jumping = -1 hearth, you can get them back with achivements, which give you +1 hearth each
body:
**HearthBreaker Challenge**

**_You jump -> You loose 1 hearth_**

_Gain them back by Completing Achivements!_
> To start the Challenge write

```
/challenge start
```

> You can end it by executing

```
/challenge stop
```


**Issues? -> Write me on discord**

> Have fun,
**dervarex**
